# Test fixtures

## `real/` - real Overpass responses (ODbL)

Unmodified responses of `https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter` for the bbox
`(51.40, 7.30, 51.55, 7.55)` (Dortmund / Bochum / Witten / Hagen, NRW),
captured on 2026-10-27 via overpass-turbo.

| File | Query | OSM snapshot |
|---|---|---|
| `dortmund_substations_center.json` | 110/220/380 kV `power=substation`, `out center tags` | 2026-10-27T18:36:06Z |
| `dortmund_transformers_center.json` | `power=transformer` inside those substation areas, `out center tags` | 2026-10-27T18:46:17Z |

Data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database
License (ODbL 1.0), https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright.

They were requested with `out center` (no polygons), so they test the parsers
on real tagging and the degraded path where transformers cannot be assigned.

## `synthetic/` - invented data in Overpass `out geom` format

Generated by `synthetic/build_fixture.py`. IDs 900000+ / 910000+ are **not**
real OSM objects. Every element reproduces one situation seen in the real
sample (e.g. "Station Alpha" = the Station Wambel pattern) or one edge case
required by the task (invalid geometry, unit variants, duplicates, rejects).
`manifest.json` has the sha256 of both tiles, like a real fetch.
